supporting_observations.claim: Zeek records show WS-LMARTINS-01 making several TCP connections to 10.40.20.30:8080 during the alert window, including at 13:36:11, 13:41:10, 13:51:18, 13:55:49, 14:00:52, and 14:06:11 UTC. Several are roughly five minutes apart, although the intervals are not uniformly five minutes.

The observed cadence is compatible with the documented PixelForge updater check frequency, but these records do not identify the destination website or the process responsible, so they do not establish that the activity was the PixelForge updater.
The supplied Zeek records identify connections to the proxy address and port, but do not show the external HTTPS destination for these sessions.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage information reports a collection outage on WS-LMARTINS-01 for winsec and Sysmon, and on PROXY-NWD-01 for proxy logs, from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. Thus, process attribution and proxy destination/request details are unavailable for the alert window.
Zeek connection telemetry is available, but the supplied records for the interval show connections to the internal proxy rather than the external HTTPS destinations.
claims_not_established: Whether the observed proxy sessions were the periodic HTTPS activity described by the alert, and which external hostnames or URLs they reached.
Whether pfupdater.exe, another legitimate application, or an untrusted process initiated the sessions.
Whether the sessions transferred content or exhibited other malicious behavior; the available connection records do not establish this.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, request details, and any available TLS inspection or SNI data.
Obtain endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-LMARTINS-01 covering the same interval to identify the process responsible for the sessions.
Verify whether pfupdater.exe ran during the interval and whether it contacted updates.pixelforge-suite.com, using updater logs and executable identity or signature information.
